title: jit_expr
description: The `jit_expr` package provides a just-in-time compiled family of expression evaluators: `jit/expr` processes control data, while `jit/expr~` and `jit/fexpr~` process audio signals. Expressions can use typed inlet variables such as `$f#`, `$i#`, `$s#`, and `$v#`, and a bang causes `jit/expr` to evaluate its expression.
